author: GaryMarcus
text:
This is crazy. In late July, "three guys with Claude and Codex subscriptions" were able to use Opus 5 to access OAI auth tokens and gain write access to OpenAI's monorepo openai/openai over the course of two days. 

https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/hackers-used-anthropics-claude-to-break-into-openai-b40ba883
